name: Shidou Kaede
source:
3rd year high school student.
Hobby: Reading (Novels Only), Texting

Kenji's classmate and class representative.
She is quiet and calm, manages the class, and is well-liked because of her good looks.
For some reason, she has an abnormal dislike for manga, which has led to conflicts with the protagonist on multiple occasions. Her hobby is novels, but she also dislikes manga and light novels and other illustrations, saying that "they give me goosebumps." She lives with her grandfather in a bookstore, and occasionally works at the store as a clerk. Her goal seems to be to get rid of the manga section one day. Contrary to her image, she is also addicted to texting on her cell phone, writing lengthy messages that are on par with novels. She is also an extremely good mahjong player, loves to gossip about other people, and is a mysterious character.
